description.zh:
身份类型。

- USER：仅用户名。

- CLIENT：具体到客户端。
description.en:
The identity type. Valid values:

*   USER
*   CLIENT

description.zh: 微消息队列 MQTT 版实例的 ID。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance.

description.zh: 授权的Topic，支持mqtt多级topic与通配符。
description.en: The topic on which you want to grant permissions. Multi-level topics and Wildcard characters are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt delete-custom-auth-permission --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000 --identity-type USER --identity test --topic test/t1 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt DeleteCustomAuthPermission --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000' --Identity test --Topic 'test/t1'
